column1: # Curated overrides for the PANTHER member index (.cache/panther/panther-members-<release>.tsv), applied by `just refresh-panther-members`
# after the PANTHER classification files and UniProt fallback. Use only where a
# curator has decided which family assignment is right; every row needs a reason.
# See PR #3849 for the origin of the rows below. Rows marked "pinned until" are
# provisional: the durable fix is to re-point the family review and drop the row.

column3: Same-protein node disagreement: PANTHER 19.0 per-organism classification gives PTHR24056:SF375 (also named CYCLIN-DEPENDENT KINASE 7; adopted deliberately in the 2026-09-25 cell_cycle_progression refresh), UniProt xref_panther and the PTHR24056 family review give SF0; pinned to SF0 until the family review is re-pointed
UniProt xref_panther and the PTHR24250 family review agree on SF27; regeneration in #3821 moved it

UniProt xref_panther and the PTHR36695 family review give SF12. PANTHER's per-organism classification gives PTHR18945:SF430 (nicotinic-receptor-related), but the published Cys-loop phylogeny places Dmel NTR outside both nicotinic acetylcholine-receptor groups (PMID:30429615, Extended Data Figure 10d; cited in PTHR36695-review.yaml)

Same-protein node disagreement: PANTHER per-organism classification gives PTHR42912:SF95 (same name, METHYLTRANSFERASE TYPE 11 DOMAIN-CONTAINING PROTEIN), UniProt xref_panther and the PTHR44942 family review give SF4; pinned until the family review is re-pointed
UniProt xref_panther and the PTHR45080 family review agree on SF21; regeneration in #3821 moved it
UniProt xref_panther and the PTHR46721 family review agree on SF3; regeneration in #3821 moved it

Same-protein node disagreement: PANTHER per-organism classification gives PTHR48013:SF8 (also named MAP2K2), UniProt xref_panther and the PTHR47448 family review give SF3; pinned until the family review is re-pointed

UniProt xref_panther (DR PANTHER line) and the PTHR48004 family review give SF58; the record carries LRR domains (InterPro LRR_dom_sf, Pfam LRR_1 x3, LRR_8). Its RIC7 SubName is a legacy AT4G28560 label: the CRIB-motif RIC7 is AT4G28556 / Q1G3K8 (history/genes/ARATH/Q1G3K8), so PTHR48004:SF38 (RIC7) is not adopted

Dicty splB/Pyk2. PANTHER 19.0 classification and tree put it in PTHR23257:SF975 (DUAL SPECIFICITY PROTEIN KINASE SPLB), inside a Dictyostelium-only TKL clade (PTN009067480), and its IBAs (GO:0004672, GO:0005737, GO:0007165) come from PTN001148170, a node just below the PTHR23257 root whose PAINT leaves in the reference proteomes are all PTHR23257. UniProt/InterPro 110.0 xref_panther PTHR44329:SF298 is an HMM best-hit on the same PANTHER 19.0 release; splB is not a leaf of the PTHR44329 tree. UniProt value rejected; see PTHR44329-review.yaml notes

Dicty pyk3. PANTHER 19.0 classification and tree put it in PTHR23257:SF969 with its D. purpureum ortholog (clade PTN009067596), and its IBAs come from PTHR23257 node PTN001148170. UniProt/InterPro 110.0 xref_panther PTHR44329:SF298 is an HMM best-hit on the same release; pyk3 is not a leaf of the PTHR44329 tree. UniProt value rejected; see PTHR44329-review.yaml notes

Dicty drkA. PANTHER 19.0 classification and tree put it in PTHR23257:SF921 with its paralogs drkB, kxcB and roco5 (clade PTN002758693), and its IBAs come from PTHR23257 node PTN001148170. UniProt/InterPro 110.0 xref_panther PTHR44329:SF298 is an HMM best-hit on the same release; drkA is not a leaf of the PTHR44329 tree. UniProt value rejected; see PTHR44329-review.yaml notes

Dicty gbpC. PANTHER 19.0 classification and tree put it in PTHR23257:SF711 (CYCLIC GMP-BINDING PROTEIN C) with its D. purpureum ortholog, in a Dictyostelium clade (PTN004623322), and its IBAs come from PTHR23257 node PTN001148170. UniProt/InterPro 110.0 xref_panther PTHR44329:SF288 is an HMM best-hit on the same release. UniProt value rejected; see PTHR44329-review.yaml notes

Human MAP3K20. UniProt xref_panther gives PTHR44329:SF288, where PANTHER 19.0 itself classifies its mouse, rat, cow, Xenopus and zebrafish orthologs (Q9ESL4, D4AE17 and others; mouse and rat take MAP3K IBAs from PTHR44329 nodes). PANTHER's per-organism file gives PTHR43289:SF13 because the human leaf is grafted at maximal branch length (2.0) into a Homininae NEK6 clade (PTN002878625) of the PTHR43289 tree, which is what gives MAP3K20 its NEK6-derived IBAs (GO:0007059, GO:0030071 from PTN002878623). Treated as a PANTHER placement artifact; PTHR44329:SF288 adopted

Dicty phg2. PANTHER 19.0 classification and tree put it in PTHR23257:SF776 (SERINE_THREONINE-PROTEIN KINASE PHG2) with its D. purpureum ortholog and DDB_G0282963 (clade PTN002758685), and its IBAs come from PTHR23257 node PTN001148170. UniProt/InterPro 110.0 xref_panther PTHR46716:SF1 (TAK1) is an HMM best-hit on the same release; phg2 is not a leaf of the Bilateria-rooted PTHR46716 tree and carries no TAK1-specific InterPro signature. UniProt value rejected; see PTHR46716-review.yaml notes

C. elegans mom-4. PANTHER 19.0 classification and tree put it in PTHR23257:SF958 in an Ecdysozoa speciation clade (PTN007744917) with its C. briggsae ortholog, fly Takl2 and a Daphnia MAP3K, at ordinary branch lengths (not a grafting artifact), and its IBAs come from PTHR23257 node PTN001148170. UniProt/InterPro 110.0 xref_panther PTHR46716:SF1 is an HMM best-hit on the same release; mom-4 is not a leaf of the PTHR46716 tree. This pins PANTHER family membership only: MOM-4 remains a functional TAK1 homolog (PTHR46716-review.yaml notes)
